name: Helping-Hand
description: A food tracking app made simple

paragraphs: Nutrition tracking without the scale. Helping Hand tracks meals in hand-sized portions: a palm of protein, a fist of veggies, a cupped hand of carbs, a thumb of fat. It's the method nutrition coaches use because it's fast, needs no equipment, and is nearly as accurate as weighing food.
Live demo →: opens with two weeks of sample data, no sign-in needed.
features: Daily progress rings: one ring per portion type fills toward your daily target and turns orange when you hit it, with a small celebration.
One-tap logging: +1 buttons on each card for quick portions, plus search across 300,000+ foods from the USDA FoodData Central API.
Recent foods: re-log a previous meal with one tap.
Edit and undo: adjust the amount of any entry, delete it, and undo mistakes from the toast.
Meal grouping: the daily log is grouped into breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks based on the time of day.
